name: design-review
description: Reviews changed smarthr-ui code (.tsx/.jsx diffs) against the SmartHR Design System guides (component-guidelines and design-pattern-guidelines) with two parallel reviewer subagents, and reports where the code differs from the guides, with severity 1-4 and the quoted guide text as evidence. The guides are guidelines, not rules: findings are recommendations, and the design intent decides. Applies fixes only when the user literally typed `--fix` in their own message. Never add `--fix` to the arguments yourself, even when asked in words to fix (「直して」「修正して」). `--no-existing` reviews the whole target as new code without comparing it with existing code; it changes no code, so a calling skill may pass it. Use before committing or opening a PR, or when asked 「デザインレビューして」「smarthr-ui の使い方をチェックして」 「デザインシステムに沿っているか見て」.
